violations.reason: Active codebase violation from an approved concern recorded in PR #1353: Modifications to docker-compose.override.yml health check and backup crontab are outside the strict frontend UI scope.

Active codebase violation from an approved concern recorded in PR #1348: The PR includes additional UI features in frontend/index.html (e.g., data export and delete account confirmation modal) that are beyond the strict scope of the SSO error fallback login flow.

The entrypoint script in docker-compose.override.yml fakes success without doing real work: it swallows the failure of a missing or misconfigured backup script by merely echoing 'Backup script not found or is directory' and continuing to start the cron daemon, bypassing the required backup check.

The client brief requires fixing HTTP 401 rejections on API endpoints expected to return 200/201 (causing 15 test failures on main), but the merged PRs contain no backend code addressing this authentication defect.
